svg.title: Veterinarian revised activity diagram
svg.desc: Current iPawcus workflow, reviewed 19 October 2026. Alternative activity branches use decisions and merges; actor labels identify responsibility.
svg.text: email verification, token, and role access
Assigned clinical care, online consultations, record work, prescriptions/certificates, review, and availability
Current local implementation reviewed: 19 October 2026 | Rounded box: activity | Diamond: decision / merge | Small label: responsible actor
Columns are alternative work areas. Merge diamonds combine alternatives; they do not wait for every activity to finish. Pending reviews may be revisited later.
Use the selected action's validation rules. For a timeout or uncertain write result, refresh the record before resubmitting. Leaving an activity returns to the menu.
Current My List is populated by Admin queue assignment. Do not add a compulsory separate Approved List / receive-case screen.
Diagnosis finalization checks the assigned completed intake where installed. Clinical completion creates/reuses billing context; it does not verify payment.
Online availability is a separate recurring call-start calendar. Published branch visits are retired. Only the actual veterinarian role issues medical certificates.
